_why: Dropped 39 → 31 when the scanner's IGNORE list grew to cover per-CLI entrypoint scaffolding (argv/args/ROOT) alongside the `main` that was already there. Nine standalone PATH executables each parse argv and resolve their own root because they must not import across that boundary; renaming them one at a time to satisfy a counter was making the code worse, which is the gate distorting the codebase rather than guarding it. Domain names — budget, BUDGET_FILE, DESC — are deliberately still caught.
